map.A/B测试显著性计算器 使用指南: A/B Test Significance Calculator User Guide
map.输入两组曝光与转化数据，计算 A/B 测试的统计显著性，判断版本差异是真实效果还: Enter two sets of impression and conversion data to compute the statistical significance of an A/B test and judge whether the version difference is a real effect or random noise.
map.两个落地页转化 10% vs 13%，判断差异是否真显著。: Two landing pages convert at 10% vs 13% - judge whether the difference is really significant.
map.决定要不要全量推胜出版本，还是继续放量收集数据。: Decide whether to roll out the winning version in full or keep ramping to gather more data.
map.避免把随机波动误当成「显著提升」过早下结论。: Avoid mistaking random noise for a 'significant lift' and concluding too early.
map.：A 组 200/2000=10%，B 组 260/2000=13%，两比例 z: : group A 200/2000 = 10%, group B 260/2000 = 13%, two-proportion z ≈ 2.45, two-sided p ≈ 0.014 < 0.05 -> the difference is significant at 95% confidence, so B can be rolled out in full.
map.：若 p>0.05（如只差 0.5 个百分点且样本小），结论为「尚不显著」，应继: : if p > 0.05 (for example only a 0.5 percentage point gap with a small sample), the conclusion is 'not yet significant'; keep collecting data or enlarge the sample rather than rolling out rashly.
map.p<0.05 就一定该推吗？: If p < 0.05, should it always be rolled out?
map.p<0.05 只说明差异不太可能由随机造成，还要看提升幅度与业务成本，微小显著也: p < 0.05 only says the difference is unlikely to be random; you still need to weigh the lift size against business cost - a tiny but significant lift may still not pay off.
map.样本不够怎么办？: What if the sample is not enough?
map.按期望提升与基线算出所需样本量再开测，中途看「趋势」停测容易误判。: Compute the required sample size from the expected lift and baseline before starting the test; stopping midway because a 'trend' appears invites misjudgment.
